name: Riddledale
description:
About This Game



The world of Riddledale is filled with fantastic creatures and wizards. Follow Wilburn on his journey home after years abroad. Meet Ralph, your new companion, and embark on a quest to solve the riddle of the crystals. As he explores the island, Wilburn soon discovers that the place where he grew up has changed over the years, and that a dangerous secret now lies beneath the island.




Riddledale is a new open-world adventure centered on story and characters. Solve riddles, experience memorable encounters, and fight ferocious creatures across a vast island full of secrets.




Riddledale is filled with creatures and enemies. You will need to be swift to defeat them, but above all you must be prepared. Rest well, plan your expeditions, and gather food and supplies before setting out. Combine your combat skills with Ralph’s powerful spells to overcome your foes.


Collecting resources is essential. Use them to brew potent potions, cook delicious meals, and craft powerful tools and weapons. Hone your crafting and gathering skills to unlock hidden quests and uncover unexplored locations.


Riddledale is built around storytelling. The world and its characters evolve as the story progresses, and so do your relationships with your friends. Dialogues and quests will guide you on your journey, but freely exploring the island will always lead to new, fun, and unusual encounters.





Riddledale is a volcanic island in the middle of the sea, located between the western and eastern continents. Ancient ruins from an extinct civilization still cover the island, but the cause of its fall remains unknown. In more recent years, the town of Riddledale has grown into a popular tourist destination, and its new mining operations are rapidly putting the long-forgotten island back on the map.




Visit the official website to learn more about the game. Join the community for a chance to participate in exclusive beta tests before release.
